text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- First consignment of medical supplies arrives in Iraq under oil-for-food deal.
- Oil Minister Rasheed says Iraq will soon sign large oil deals with China and France.
- Health Minister Mubarak says at WHO meeting in Geneva that U.S. is blocking Iraq's oil-for-food deal.
- Speaker of National Assembly Hammadi meets head of Jordanian council of deputies in Amman.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Spain to organise trade fair in Baghdad later this month.
- Foreign Minister Sahaf discusses ties with visiting Turkish Energy Minister Kutan.
